# phare_integration_outgoing_webhook (Resource)

Manages an outgoing webhook integration in Phare, sending alerts as signed HTTP requests to a URL. Integrations belong to the organization and are used by alert rules to send notifications. [See docs](https://docs.phare.io/integrations/outgoing-webhook).

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "phare_integration_outgoing_webhook" "automation" {
  name = "Automation webhook"

  settings = {
    url    = "https://example.com/webhooks/phare"
    secret = var.webhook_secret
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name, must be unique across all the integrations of the organization
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the outgoing webhook integration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date of creation
- `id` (Number) Integration ID
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the integration is paused, integrations can only be paused from the control panel
- `updated_at` (String) Date of last update

<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret used to sign the webhook requests (10-250 characters), [see docs](https://docs.phare.io/integrations/outgoing-webhook#delivery-details). The API never returns this value, it is kept from the Terraform state and changes made outside of Terraform are not detected.
- `url` (String) URL receiving the webhook requests (up to 250 characters)
